nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Conservation farming|Biological pest control_qna_000
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: Why are bioherbicides based on allelochemical molecules considered advantageous over chemical herbicides?
nodes.answer: Bioherbicides are advantageous because they have multisite actions, unlike chemical herbicides that have a well-defined single site of action.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Conservation farming|Biological pest control_qna_001
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What are biopesticides and what are they derived from?
nodes.answer: Biopesticides are natural products used to control weeds and can be based on natural metabolites produced by living organisms, including plants and microbes.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Conservation farming|Biological pest control_qna_002
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: Why are agrochemical companies interested in biopesticides?
nodes.answer: Agrochemical companies are becoming increasingly interested in eco-friendly products and are investing in the research and development of biopesticides.
